posts.text: @kiraank , Thanks for sharing that article. Fairchem’s Q1FY27 improvement was driven mainly by better dimer acid realizations as Chinese dumping/import pressure eased, with only modest volume growth, so the recovery is still largely external rather than fully structural. This is something management themselves have acknowledged they have absolutely no control over. The key challenge is whether Chinese competition stays subdued; there is evidence dumping has reduced, but not enough to call it permanent.
